rows.name: Cherry Blossom Hill
rows.description: 山丘顶端有一棵巨大的古老樱花树，树冠如云。周围是绿油油的草地，点缀着飘落的粉色瓣。背景可以俯瞰整座城市的远景。黄昏时分，夕阳将一切染成金橘色。
rows.prompt: A wide establishing shot of a massive ancient cherry blossom tree on top of a grassy hill, pink flowers in full bloom, soft grass covered in fallen petals. Background shows a distant suburban town under a sunset sky with orange and purple hues. Golden hour lighting, long shadows, romantic and cinematic atmosphere. Shot on 35mm wide-angle lens. High detail, 8K resolution, photorealistic. No people in the scene, focus on environment and atmosphere.
